Step 3. The Hermitian operator \(Q_{01360013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle Q_{01360013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the linear convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01360011 \cdot C_01360012 \cdot C_01360013\).
